name: lildocs
description: A lightweight CLI that turns Markdown docs into a static searchable documentation site.

scripts.format: oxfmt --write src package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode/settings.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode/settings.json
